reason: The indexing and systematic absences strongly support the orthorhombic cell, and the Au-dominated intensities plausibly support a Pnnn average Au framework with Z = 2, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. The only submitted model has a reported full-profile Rwp-like residual of about 8.37% on a clean pattern, while the comparable-score report is unavailable. The trajectory selected O and especially Li sites from approximate deconvolved intensities plus geometric screening; independent charge flipping did not complete, several distinct Li/O Wyckoff realizations had close fit objectives, and no lower-symmetry or other materially distinct light-atom ordering was instantiated and compared as a CIF. Thus the submitted symmetry, light-atom coordinates, and discrete ordering remain materially ambiguous, and another solution attempt could plausibly improve the candidate set.
